message.content: Based on the conversation, Li Hua mentioned several standout scenes from The Witcher 3. One of the most memorable scenes for Li Hua occurred when Geralt was searching for Yennefer in the early part of the game. Li Hua noted that "the way the game intertwines their past and present is just brilliantly done. It really sets the stage for their complex relationship!" Additionally, Li Hua highlighted the "Battle of Kaer Morhen" scene, describing it as "super intense" due to the emotional stakes for Geralt and Yennefer, making it a powerful and unforgettable moment in the game. Li Hua also appreciated the chemistry between Geralt and Yennefer, stating that their relationship adds significant depth to the game.
